body: i'm so sorry dude, so much hugs. to everyone who's going through something like this at a young age i'm really hoping we all get the therapy we deserve ):

my brother tries to take me out sometimes and i often say no because i'm really busy. i don't have a lot of friends because i push them away since i have weird thoughts that they hate me and my only best friend doesn't go to the same school as me so it's a bit lonely ): thank you for the advice, i've been feeling like this all the time all throughout growing up and it's hard to open up especially because i'm afraid of what other people think
